create.name: Arthur Samuel Joseph
create.bio:
Arthur Samuel Joseph is a voice teacher and the founder of the Vocal Awareness Institute. He began studying singing as a teenager, went on to a master's degree in music, and has spent around sixty years developing Vocal Awareness, a method that uses breath, warm-ups and short daily rituals to help people speak and sing from a settled, authentic sense of self. He was once on the theatre faculty of the University of Southern California, has been a visiting artist at Yale and George Washington University, and coached broadcasters, athletes, actors and speakers.

Although much of his work is with leaders and performers, he describes the voice as a doorway to inner awareness, and his teaching links breathing, body and attention with what he calls the deeper self. People can begin with a free seven-day challenge, practise daily through his Inner Circle app, work through a self-paced curriculum, or apply for a small live mentorship group or private coaching. His books include The Sound of the Soul, Vocal Power and Vocal Leadership.

books.title: The Sound of the Soul: Discovering the Power of Your Voice
books.author: Arthur Samuel Joseph
books.description: An introduction to the Vocal Awareness method, with short daily exercises that treat the voice as a way into self-awareness and a fuller sense of who you are.

books.title: Vocal Power: Harnessing the Power Within
books.author: Arthur Samuel Joseph
books.description: Sound-making and breathing warm-ups for freeing the voice, paired with practice in concentration and moving past the emotional habits that hold people back.

books.title: Vocal Power: Harness Your Inner Voice to Conquer Everyday Communication Challenges
books.author: Arthur Samuel Joseph
books.description: Practical exercises for posture, vocal quality and focus in everyday speaking, with a closing chapter on singing for pleasure.

books.title: Vocal Leadership: 7 Minutes a Day to Communication Mastery
books.author: Arthur Samuel Joseph
books.description: A seven-minute daily routine for building presence and confidence as a speaker, aimed at people who lead teams or address audiences.

courses.title: Vocal Awareness Inner Circle App
courses.description: A membership app with short guided vocal and breathing routines for each day, warm-ups for particular occasions and an accountability system.

courses.title: Vocal Awareness Mastery Tools System
courses.description: His full self-paced video curriculum on the seven rituals of Vocal Awareness, with workbooks and lasting access to the platform.

courses.title: Empowerment Through Voice Mastermind
courses.description: A small live group led by Arthur over weekly coaching calls, with individual feedback and a practice plan for each member. Entry is by application.

courses.title: Private Coaching with Arthur Samuel Joseph
courses.description: One-to-one work with Arthur for a handful of people each year, chosen by application.

free_resources.title: 7-Day Vocal Power Challenge
free_resources.description: A free week of seven-minute daily voice and breathing practices, sent by email, as a starting point for the method.
